steps.name: Memories of Medea (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Kali” and visit [Xena] in “Zisk Territory.”

lines.text: (Medea looks up at the sky and continues fiddling with the object in her hands. Then, she smiles happily as she sees %s in her field of vision.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I was waiting. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris Did your conversation end well? You must have eaten delicious food at Seolhwa, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I was already really hungry. But what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris I would like to tell you a story about me that you may not know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you mind?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although it pains me to retell Weiss' evil deeds, Iris needs to know this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That way, many lives will be saved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Medea’s eyes look sad….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please follow me.

steps.name: Memories of Medea (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at “Lake of Oblivion” and obtain <Tears of Welcome>. Then, complete the quest to [Xena] in “Jisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Hello Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jenna. How are you?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I always have a good time here. It's a pity that I can't go outside the territory... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother and Adventurer come to visit often, Iris sometimes talks to me, and I like it because my son here plays with me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … Seeing that the ominous presence and bad vibes in the territory have clearly disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Adventurer, including your brother, must have solved a big problem.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hello, Jenna. I heard this from Jiscard. nice to see you. I am… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Those ears... . Maybe Medea… Are you

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, I know that you are a superhuman just like my brother. And I feel like I've seen you a long time ago. Oh, I may have seen it alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry. Because I didn't recognize it... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: No. are you okay. But what happened here... .
(Jenna discovers something faintly glowing in Medea's hand.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I think I saw something similar inside the lakeshore. Since it was something I couldn't do anything about, I just left it alone... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. That will be helpful for me and Iris.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Is that so? Then come to me with that item. perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because of our clan… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's not Medea's fault. That's what the witch did.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then I'll be back. %s, let’s go. To find tears of welcome at the lakeside... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Memories of Medea (3)
steps.objective: Complete the quest with [Jenna] after talking to her in a secluded place in “Jisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Did you find your item?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thanks to you, I found it. Thanks to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The view from the end of the lake was too good to say it was thanks to me... . So what should I do now?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please follow me. You can talk there. Maybe I have a story to tell.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Now, come this way.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The lakeside here no longer feels murky. Vice disappeared along with the power of purgatory... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: No one will ever die unjustly again, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We will all do our best to prevent that from happening.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That should be it... .
(Mediah carefully looks at the tears of welcome in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: In the past, when Adventurer came to Jisk's territory and learned about my truth, I remembered a little more.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is the story of the Kali people. It's probably not a coincidence that Mediah came with Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, it doesn't happen by chance. then… .
(Medea removes part of the tear of illusion and drops it on the floor. The fallen pieces turn into powder and scatter from the tip of Medea's staff.)
(And the image of someone appears as a blurry shadow in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Father… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I never thought I would see that scene again. But it seems a little different than before...)

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: You don't even know grace!! I just helped your clan avoid suffering from the Deimos Church and Kingdom... . Why do we… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am grateful to the lord for helping our clan. But your kingdom did something it should not have done.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You came into contact with another ‘witch’. And I would have asked you for something.

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: … What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Howl's kingdom wants the witch's power... . In that case, it was meaningless for the lord to help us... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I ended up helping Weiss, who was trying to kill my family... .

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: Are you really unable to give up being a ‘witch’?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I can't help it. I live, my family lives… . And for the sake of a child who is the same as me but has a slightly different destiny... .

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: … How many times did that child, Medea, open her eyes again? Back when Jenna took care of me... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Did you know? Then I won't be able to keep the lord alive... .

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: This witch!! I will curse you until the very end!! Close from the beginning... . Doing... . It wasn't... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If our clan is to survive, this child must become strong. How much longer will it take for a child born with the life of a witch to become perfect? .
(The lord's image scatters like sand and disappears, and the image of Weiss appears around Daphne. The story continues with different topics and does not mix together.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Medea, my dear child... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: We need the power of the Kali people with pure souls. You weakling, don’t disturb me!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I made a mistake in helping you momentarily, but it will not work out the way you wanted.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: How did you know that the gods of the past sealed Coral City? I could have used the foolish king of fishmen... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It's okay though. If there is this much life force and the Kali people... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This child was so precious to me that I thought of him as a part of me, as much as my soul.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Poor person... . That wasn't in the contract, so why are they preventing me from killing Daphne?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Because that’s what He wants.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A hindrance... , If you can't kill it, the only way is to drop it into a gap in time and space... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This magic stone… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Maybe it's the Kali people... , A magic stone containing the power of life that may or may not be. Why do you need it... ?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Medea… . I didn't disappear because I wanted to disappear... . media… .
(Daphne is no longer visible in the illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I think Daphne was trying to show it on purpose.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we go back to the lakeside?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now that you know everything, let me go ahead and summarize it for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It’s okay… .
(Medea walks away first, showing a small smile as if to tell her not to worry.)

steps.name: Memories of Medea (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Zisk Territory Algoa] in “Zisk Territory” to obtain <Zisk Blueberry>. Then return to [Jenna] and complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To me and to Jenna... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now that I've sorted things out in my head, I'll tell you now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you mind?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay, %s.
(Medea drops tears of welcome on the floor. The object containing Daphne's memories shatters as it touches the tip of the cane, which is violently lowered.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You don't need this. Because now I feel like I know who I am. I don’t know what number of births this is, but… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Kali clan has a pure soul compared to other humans. So pure that it becomes the basis for the magic stone created by Weiss... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: While trying to protect her clan, she made a mistake the moment the lord who helped her clan discovered that she was a witch.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: While emphasizing that the clan is human… . To abandon humanity and choose the life of a 'witch'... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So I made a deal with Vice in the name of protecting the clan.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Youngju, Jiscard, and Jenna… . And he did something terrible to all the lives in the territory. sorry.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's not Medea's fault.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. therefore… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think the reason he did that was the same for me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you Medea?
(Mediah raises her head and looks gently at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know when I was first born... . I died when I was twelve years old. Not only me, but also many Kali children died like that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Children who are born die, and even living people are attacked by Vice... . As a last resort, he made a deal with Vice... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you take care of the affairs of Jisk's territory, he will give you a magic stone filled with the power of life... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So some of the dying children survived. He knew that in the process, I would become a witch.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know if you wanted me to awaken as a witch and be by your side, or if you wanted something else.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Under the influence of the magic stone, the children were gradually able to live with the power of life. However, only me and Beynon died and woke up again and again... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Me and Beynon’s memories have been erased… . Every time I was given a new life, I believed that was all, and He must have thought it was the best.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At that time, the village elders were vaguely aware of it. Why did I have to live... . Why did he keep me alive... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then he disappeared. Did Vice send it somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The clan whose leader disappeared was attacked by the Deimos Church, and in that situation, they had to make a final choice. Without knowing that it was the wrong choice... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To save me, the adults threw themselves into the vortex of mana that protected Kali Village, believing that I would protect my clan.
(Media repeatedly sobs as if unable to overcome her rising emotions. Adventurer and Jenna wait, covering Mediah.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry… . Can I lie down for a moment?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, please get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea. Just like Jenna said, get some rest.
(Jenna checks the condition of Medea, who is lying down, with worried eyes.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: There was definitely something good about controlling my emotions... . ah!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, can you find some blueberries in my estate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Blueberries?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Zisk blueberries are very helpful in stabilizing the mind and body. If you follow Algeson, you will find him quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Adventurer, you are here. Were there any blueberries?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there was some left where Algeson was. Medea, you will calm down now.
(Take off a purple blueberry and bring it to Medea's mouth. Medea opens her eyes at the approaching sweet scent.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is... .
(After Mediah carefully tastes the blueberries, she holds out her hand to %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could you please give me more?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… . I know what this tastes like.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Blueberries from Jisk Estate... . It tastes the same as the blueberries harvested in Cali. Perhaps in the territory as part of exchange... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah, I remember that too. When I was young, farmers liked it because it was a new fruit.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It breaks my heart to think of what could have been a good relationship falling apart... . By the way, Youngji’s blueberries are a little sweeter.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you soak it in alcohol, Jiscard will like it... . Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm glad you're feeling better. Would you like to rest a little longer?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … no. I have to keep telling you what I know so that both Iris and Jiscard will know.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please don't look at me like that. Because this is a story I have to tell... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm. How far did we go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, seniors… .  I was able to protect some, including young children, thanks to the strength of those who died on their own.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The process led me, who had been slightly extended my life by the power of the magic stone, to death again... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The sins he committed and the memory of some... . Maybe they're witches... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then, I was able to live again. Not dead. I found out later that it was the grace of Gaia, who had awakened at that time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A destiny that I, including him, did not know about... . From then on, I will live the life of a witch and a superhuman... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's something I haven't told you, but through this event, I gave the divine power I received from Gaia to Iris. For Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, Medea!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That doesn't mean I'll live the life of a witch. My trust in God will only grow in the future. Iris will be watching over you… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Because no more superhumans with similar fates, including me, should appear on this earth... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay. Because the curse of death that was on me has already been lifted. With the power of Perse given by Shinik... .  Now my story is over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: No. Thanks to you, it also helped my memory.  Thank you for speaking for me and for your brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All superhumans had this fate... Is everything really going to be okay now...? Not yet for Medea...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Medea… . I want to hug you, but your body is like this... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could you please sing to me instead of hugging me? Jiscard kept bragging about our Jenna. I wanted to hear it.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah, my brother... . It's not a skill I'm proud of, but... . I have a song that I practiced, so I'll let you hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to hear it too, Jenna.
(Jenna nods with a bright face. She then closes her eyes and catches her breath.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I hope my song reaches you... ♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Under the same sky that I kept hoping for and hoping for... ♬
(Xena's song, wishing for everyone's happiness, continues. Medea's anxious feelings also slowly, little by little, flow to the shore of the lake of oblivion and disappear.)
